author: More Perfect Union
description:
There's a scourge of NDAs surrounding data center development — tech billionaires are getting local politicians to keep their projects a secret.

People around the country are increasingly outraged to find that their politicians have signed on to agreements proposed by the oligarchs at Meta, xAI, Anthropic and elsewhere that allow tech giants to hold them to secrecy.

We went down to Louisiana and talked to folks who say this is a crisis of corruption.

Producer: @wadrewhawkins
Editor: @kungaaaaaaaa
Supervising Producer: Court Fuller
title: How Tech Billionaires Are Using NDAs to Hide Data Center Deals

author: More Perfect Union
description:
Latino voters in South Texas’s reddest district are turning on Trump.

1 in 5 regret their choice — now a Democrat could win them back.

We sat down with Bobby Pulido and Latino Trump voters. Some voted for him 3x, but they say prices are too high and ICE is out of control.
